---
title: "主力—机会场六比一与五比二候选组合"
format: html
execute:
  error: true
  warning: false
---

本报告把场次标签和固定预算组合排序连接起来。组合只允许 6 主力 + 1 机会或 5 主力 + 2 机会；排除场不进入组合。回报仍是赛前欧赔代理，最终收益必须以北单结算复核。

```{r}
source("r/role_combo_generator.R")
source("r/candidate_combo_rank.R")
fixtures <- data.frame(fixture_id = as.character(1:9),
  role = c(rep("主力", 7), rep("机会", 2)))
combos <- generate_role_combinations(fixtures, max_candidates = 100)
metrics <- data.frame(combo_id = combos$combo_id,
  hit_probability = seq_len(nrow(combos)) / (nrow(combos) + 10),
  expected_gross = 300 + seq_len(nrow(combos)), stake_cny = 128,
  legal_mass = .9)
ranked <- rank_role_combinations(combos, metrics, budget_cny = 1024)
head(ranked[, c("combo_id", "main_count", "opportunity_count",
  "budget_hit_probability", "budget_expected_net", "average_rank")])
```
